jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Experience :
3 - 6 Yrs
Location :
Bengaluru
Designation :
AI Platform Engineer

Job description

Own work end-to-end — design, build, test, ship, monitor, iterate — with production ownership and on-call.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and clear design docs; apply SOLID and sound API design.
Treat reliability, latency, cost, and observability as first-class requirements, not afterthoughts.
Build for a regulated environment: data privacy, access controls, auditability, safe handling of customer data.
Collaborate across product, data, risk, and platform to turn ambiguous problems into measurable outcomes.

Track A — Software / Platform Engineer

Build and operate model-serving, gateway, and orchestration infra (routing, caching, rate-limiting, fallbacks) for LLM/ML workloads.
Design data and RAG pipelines — ingestion, chunking, embedding jobs, vector/index stores — that stay fresh and consistent.
Build guardrails, evaluation harnesses, prompt/version management, and observability (tracing, metrics, cost attribution); harden for scale and failure.
We look for: production backend/distributed systems in a strong language (Go, Java, Python…); solid concurrency, APIs, databases, queues, and cloud infra; a reliability mindset. Deep ML theory not required.

Track B — ML / Applied-AI Engineer

Improve retrieval and RAG quality — chunking, embeddings, re-ranking, grounding — measured against real metrics.
Build agent and prompt workflows; systematically evaluate models, prompts, and pipelines with offline and online evals.
Fine-tune, adapt, or distill models where it clearly beats prompting; partner with the platform track to productionize to the same reliability bar.
We look for: production-quality Python and service ownership (not just notebooks); hands-on LLMs, embeddings/retrieval, and evaluation, plus one of fine-tuning, RAG, or agent frameworks; rigor with data and experiments.

Common bar & nice-to-haves

Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) and a track record of shipping in production.
Clear communication and a bias for reliability and correctness — especially important in fintech.
Nice to have: fintech / lending / payments or other regulated domains; LLMOps / MLOps tooling, vector DBs, eval frameworks; open-source or AI/ML side projects.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly capable machine learning engineer to optimize our machine learning systems. You will be evaluating existing machine learning (ML) processes, performing statistical analysis to resolve data set problems, and enhancing the accuracy of our AI software's predictive automation capabilities. To ensure success as a machine learning engineer, you should demonstrate solid data science knowledge and experience in a related ML role. A first-class machine learning engineer will be someone whose expertise translates into the enhanced performance of predictive automation software.

Responsibilities:

Consulting with managers to determine and refine machine learning objectives.
Designing machine learning systems and self-running artificial intelligence (AI) software to automate predictive models.
Transforming data science prototypes and applying appropriate ML algorithms and tools.
Ensuring that algorithms generate accurate user recommendations.
Turning unstructured data into useful information by auto-tagging images and text-to-speech conversions.
Solving complex problems with multi-layered data sets, as well as optimizing existing machine learning libraries and frameworks.
Developing ML algorithms to analyze huge volumes of historical data to make predictions.
Running tests, performing statistical analysis, and interpreting test results.
Documenting machine learning processes.
Keeping abreast of developments in machine learning.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in computational linguistics, data analytics, or similar will be advantageous.
At least two years' experience as a machine learning engineer.
Advanced proficiency with Python, Java, and R code writing.
Extensive knowledge of ML frameworks, libraries, data structures, data modeling, and software architecture.
In-depth knowledge of mathematics, statistics, and algorithms.
Superb analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Great communication and collaboration skills.
Excellent time management and organizational abilities.

Job Description

Join JPMorganChase to grow your software engineering career while building systems that support critical business operations. You'll collaborate globally, strengthen your technical breadth, and deliver meaningful impact.

Job Summary

As an Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within Consumer and Community Banking in our Mumbai, you will build and enhance business-critical applications as part of our Global Application Development team with close partnership across North America. You will work with us in an agile environment where secure design, strong engineering standards, and operational stability are essential. You will help shape how we design, review, and deliver solutions that can adapt quickly to changing business needs.

Job Responsibilities

Design and develop applications with a global team, contributing to end-to-end build activities and participating in peer design and code reviews.
Embed security requirements, data/information flow considerations, and corporate architecture standards into solution designs while following project lifecycle methods and IT control policies.
Translate business requirements and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and implementations, documenting specifications, platforms, components, and dependencies.
Integrate solutions consistently with existing (legacy) systems to ensure reliable end-to-end functionality across environments.
Diagnose and resolve application and system performance issues by identifying root causes and providing clear remediation recommendations.
Own and improve business-critical applications, driving cross-functional agile delivery while proposing technical, process, and innovation enhancements.
Execute and operate with strong engineering rigor (PMD, JUnit, performance testing, memory management) and disciplined production support (monitoring/alerting, third-party coordination, documentation, continuous learning, SDLC quality practices, estimation), including working 12:30 PM–9:30 PM IST overlap; leverage enterprise-authorized AI coding assist and SDLC automation tools to improve quality and speed while validating outputs through peer review, automated tests, and secure coding standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts with 5+ years of applied experience.
Hands-on enterprise development experience with Java (Java EE/J2EE), Spring, Spring Boot, and React, including debugging and maintaining production-grade code.
Practical experience across system design, SDLC, testing, and operational stability, with a strong focus on secure delivery expectations.
Strong fundamentals in RDBMS concepts, PL/SQL, ORM, and basic Linux/UNIX usage.
Proficiency with modern engineering tools and workflows including IntelliJ IDEA, Maven, Bitbucket/Git, test automation, and Jira.
Experience with web services (WSDL/WADL) and broad awareness of automation techniques across infrastructure environments; ability to use enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation to increase the value realized from automation.
Proven leadership, communication, and collaboration skills (active listening, clear written/verbal communication, adaptability across diverse work styles) and readiness to work 12:30 PM–9:30 PM IST for overlap with US teams.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Cloud Foundry, including cloud containers.
Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and practices.
Exposure to Apache Kafka or other messaging systems.
Banking, financial services, and insurance domain experience, plus deeper production experience with Spring Boot and React.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description

Job
Title:
Interns

Location:
Hyderabad, Bangalore

Position type:
Internship

About

insightsoftware provides the tools and resources to the office of the CFO to answer critical business questions to drive growth and ROI. The product offering consists of over 70 products (and growing) that provide solutions to companies of varying sizes. Users get real-time data to make the best decisions. Companies who use our products can understand overall costs, return on investment for those costs, and ways to improve their revenue and profit. insightsoftware is unique in that we offer such a wide range of products and solutions for the office of the CFO. Our goal is to better align and market these products for our existing and future customers.

Product Categories

FP&A Solutions
– tools that provide real data for the company’s finance department to achieve financial planning and analysis needs

Controllership Solutions
– tools that provide data reporting solutions for year-end, tax, and other required financial reporting

Capital Management Solutions
– tools that provide insight into the company’s asset management and risk analysis for all equity management needs

Company Details

insight software was formed in May 2018 from two companies: global software and Hubble. Since then, the company has acquired an additional 19 companies (and growing). Each year insight software targets the acquisition of 2-4 companies. Our goal as a company is to continue to integrate and align as a global organization.

Countries: 15+ countries

Size: 2000+ employees

Clients: 30,000+ organizations

Products: 70+

For more details about the organization please visit our website
www.insightsoftware.com

AI First

At insightsoftware, AI is not a side tool. It's part of how we build software, and you will be expected to work the same way. You will be expected to use AI coding assistants and other AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as an occasional shortcut.

What This Looks Like In Practice

Use AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools) to accelerate coding, debugging, and test writing, while still owning the quality and correctness of what you ship.
Apply AI tools to speed up research, documentation, and code reviews.
Bring a curious, experimental mindset: try new AI-assisted workflows, share what works with your team, and flag what doesn't.
Understand that AI output is a starting point, not a finished product. You will be responsible for validating, testing, and improving anything an AI tool generates.
Get exposure to how AI is embedded directly into our products through Lineos, AI powered by insightsoftware, giving you a front-row seat to how AI-first thinking shows up in what we ship to customers, not just how we build it.

The people who do best here will treat AI as a thinking partner, not a shortcut. You will be expected to move fast while staying sharp about what you're shipping and validating.

Job Responsibilities

Day to day tasks depend on the team you are part of. In our environment, the scrum teams are self-sustaining doing end to end work that contributes to the objectives of the scrum team. Depending on the role selected for and the team, you may do some tasks more than the others. Our teams develop software for multiple products and domain include technology platforms, web-based applications, high performance data drivers and business finance data.

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software programs for enhancements and new products.
Design and code automated tests (functional, integration and regression), run manual tests, report metrics and defects.
Design, trouble shoot CI/CD pipelines, Manage the cloud (AWS) infrastructure
Code, participate in code reviews, testing, bug bashes, and Agile rituals
Work with the team lead to build applications, assist in Research activities and POCs

Desired Skills

Our engineers have a high sense of ownership and hunger for learning. To be successful, you will need the following skills in varying degrees depending on the team you are selected for.

Experience in one or more general purpose programming languages. SQL, PL/SQL, C#, C++, Java & JavaScript are mostly used in day-to-day job. While we expect you to know one well, knowing at least two boosts your chances of being successful at job.
Experience in one or more of the unit testing tools like nunit, cppunit, xunit, junit.
Exposure to databases and data modelling.
Added Advantage if you have one or more of the below skills
Basic understanding of cloud computing in AWS, Basic understanding of DevOps – CI\CD, Source Control and build automation
API automation testing including unit test automation frameworks
understanding of testing, test methodologies and how test fits into Agile methodology
Experience in design methodologies like OOAD , Knowledge of Design patterns

Teams use the above skills to achieve success. An SDET uses programming and knowledge of testing to improve quality while an SDE uses the same skills with emphasis on building the product. Solid programming skills is a must for any role.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field
Should have studied data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis & databases; Internships, course work and additional trainings in these areas will boost your candidature.
Excellent proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us

insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team

Background checks are required for employment with insightsoftware, where permitted by country, state/province.

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. About

insightsoftware provides the tools and resources to the office of the CFO to answer critical business questions to drive growth and ROI. The product offering consists of over 70 products (and growing) that provide solutions to companies of varying sizes. Users get real-time data to make the best decisions. Companies who use our products can understand overall costs, return on investment for those costs, and ways to improve their revenue and profit. insightsoftware is unique in that we offer such a wide range of products and solutions for the office of the CFO. Our goal is to better align and market these products for our existing and future customers.

FP&A Solutions
– tools that provide real data for the company’s finance department to achieve financial planning and analysis needs

Controllership Solutions
– tools that provide data reporting solutions for year-end, tax, and other required financial reporting

Capital Management Solutions
– tools that provide insight into the company’s asset management and risk analysis for all equity management needs

Company Details

insight software was formed in May 2018 from two companies: global software and Hubble. Since then, the company has acquired an additional 19 companies (and growing). Each year insight software targets the acquisition of 2-4 companies. Our goal as a company is to continue to integrate and align as a global organization.

Countries: 15+ countries

Get exposure to how AI is embedded directly into our products through Lineos, AI powered by insightsoftware, giving you a front-row seat to how AI-first thinking shows up in what we ship to customers, not just how we build it.

Experience in one or more general purpose programming languages. SQL, PL/SQL, C#, C++, Java & JavaScript are mostly used in day-to-day job. While we expect you to know one well, knowing at least two boosts your chances of being successful at job.
